Browser-rendered photographic reproduction of the white-border [[Polarized Negative Power Coupling (Revised)]] card published by [[Decipher]]. The source page credits the photograph to Duncan Jenkins. This PNG is a technical crop of an actual browser screenshot of that photograph; it is not a native JPEG download, publisher scan or facsimile. The complete linked-photograph browser view supplied this crop because the earlier catalogue-page viewport clipped its lower edge. The page DOM, whole page screenshot and separate whole image-view screenshot are preserved distinctly; no image URL is treated as a native JPEG payload.

== Source ==
* Browser-rendered physical white-border photograph: [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=11059 collector catalogue], photograph credited to Duncan Jenkins (photograph GA08221.JPG).

== Preparation ==
The complete 1920 x 993-pixel source screenshot is retained unchanged and separately from its complete rendered page DOM. Rectangle (735, 190) to (1195, 815) was extracted with right and bottom coordinates exclusive, converted to RGB and resized using Lanczos to 350 x 476 pixels. No printed words, art, border or icons were redrawn, recolored or reconstructed. No native JPEG bytes or image HTTP200 response are claimed. The catalogue year is not first-publication evidence.
